item.title: 5-HTP (5-Hydroxytryptophan)
item.description:
What Is 5-HTP?

5-HTP (5-Hydroxytryptophan) is a naturally occurring amino acid and direct precursor to serotonin, the neurotransmitter responsible for mood, sleep, appetite, pain perception, and impulse control. It’s synthesized from the essential amino acid tryptophan, using vitamin B6 and magnesium as cofactors.

Key biochemistry:

  • Tryptophan (dietary) → 5-HTP (via TPH enzyme) → Serotonin
  • 5-HTP supplements bypass the first conversion step, directly increasing serotonin synthesis
  • Primary source for clinical use: Griffonia simplicifolia seed extract (naturally contains 20-30% 5-HTP)

item.title: SSRI Support: Supplements to Take Alongside Antidepressants
item.description:
Understanding SSRI Therapy

Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors (SSRIs) like Prozac, Zoloft, Lexapro, and Celexa are first-line treatments for depression and anxiety. While effective, they:

  • Don’t work for everyone (30-40% don’t fully respond)
  • Can cause side effects (sexual dysfunction, weight gain, sleep issues)
  • May work better with nutritional support

This guide covers supplements that may enhance SSRI therapy — and critical interactions to avoid.
